laws: Measured where measured. Reconstructed where necessary. Never invented.
Representation can exceed the source. Knowledge claims cannot exceed the evidence.

Architect_Restorer: factor validated capture gain/exposure effects out of scene identity
SceneRegistry: bind metrology provenance and authority handles
LightingStudioCicm: may not write hypothetical lighting back as captured evidence
Finisher_Exporter: may not redefine scientific scene range

authority_classes.MEASURED_SOURCE: direct sealed source or validated exact source metadata semantics
authority_classes.CALIBRATED_PHYSICAL: source-derived quantity supported by independently validated scope-matched physical calibration
authority_classes.INFERRED_SCENE: best-supported physical scene estimate from evidence plus declared model, with uncertainty
authority_classes.BOUNDED_CENSORED: source provides a one-sided or interval constraint without exact latent value
authority_classes.UNKNOWN: insufficient evidence/model support for a useful scientific claim
authority_classes.COUNTERFACTUAL: hypothetical changed world or illumination; never captured evidence
authority_classes.APPEARANCE: display/output decision; never modifies Scientific Master

required_concepts: source NoiseProfile identity and semantics status
M0_CAPTURE_DOMAIN_METROLOGY.iso_rule: ISO is factored out of scene identity only after documented measurement interpretation; ISO is never erased from provenance
M0_CAPTURE_DOMAIN_METROLOGY.capture_domain_rule: captureSampleDomainId is not a function of ISO magnitude alone

M1_SCIENTIFIC_MASTER_CONSTRUCTION.rule: same latent scene may become ISO-neutral in scene identity while preserving capture-dependent uncertainty

M3_LOCAL_ROOMCAPSULE_HANDOFF.rule: local bounded support only; preserve master/zero-line/source identity and authority tags

data_products.CaptureMetrologyPacket: source-facing capture domain, measurement and uncertainty state
data_products.SceneRangeEnvelope: nul-line-relative evidence/reconstruction range with dark/high censor bounds
data_products.SceneRadianceEvidenceField: relative camera-bound or physically calibrated scene-radiance support with explicit calibration level
data_products.IncidentLightHypothesisField: illumination/irradiance hypotheses with geometry/material model identity and uncertainty; default INFERRED_SCENE

hdr_contract.scientific_scene_hdr: SceneRangeEnvelope around nul-line; measured/reconstructed support and censor bounds

light_contract.camera_observation_primary_radiometric_c: directional scene radiance arriving at the camera, under camera response
incident_light_requires_model_support: spectral/channel calibration where physical claims require it

fail_closed_conditions: required calibration domain not exactly matched
counterfactual data is sole support for original-world claim
invariants: signed post-black scientific values not hard-clipped to zero
scene HDR is not display HDR
irradiance is not silently equated to observed radiance
counterfactual light never becomes captured evidence
FotoGraaf creates neither a 13th room nor a second Scientific Master
